messages:
lina: Quick sync: need a concise battlecard + routing plan for the upcoming benchmark webinar. Focus vs managed endpoints and infra vendors. Goal: one clear hero + two measurable subheads for A/B.

peter: Skimmed the brief. Two rules: no vendor naming in public, and any %s must have a methodology link. SDRs get percents in the locked appendix only.

maya: Bench headline suggestion for A/B: A) 'Cut token cost with adaptive batching and caching' (variant shows cost stat in subhead) B) 'Tame tail latency for production LLMs' (variant shows 95p stat).

dan: From infra side: internal runs show lower 95p under burst when routing prefers local KV; batching knocked down token cpu cost meaningfully. I'll give a 1-paragraph blurb for SDRs with caveats.

lina: Sales wants two quick counters vs 'cloud provider endpoints':
- Counter 1: 'Hidden unit economics -> Redwood surfaces and controls cost via routing and cache policies.'
- Counter 2: 'Regional latency variability -> Redwood routes to preserve SLOs and offers rollout controls.'

peter: For form routing: we should tag signups with hero_variant and interest so analytics can connect creative -> SQL. Example snippet to share with eng:
```
if signup.source == 'webinar':
  tags += ['webinar','hero_variant:A' or 'hero_variant:B']
  if signup.interest == 'infra': tags += ['interest:infra']
```
Keep tags short and SFDC-friendly.

maya: Battlecard one-pager layout proposed: 1-line claim, 2-line value prop, 3 rapid rebuttals, 1 field methodology blurb + link to appendix. Keep it skimmable.

opsbot: Reminder: assets freeze Tue EOD. Landing page copy, SDR one-pager, and benchmark appendix required.

dan: Legal note (cc Peter): avoid raw percent in public slides. I'll send the methodology blurb to Peter by EOD so he can slot percents into the locked appendix.

lina: Action items:
- Peter: file legal review for % claims (due Mon AM)
- Dan: 1-paragraph methodology for SDR appendix (due today)
- Maya: finalize 3 rebut lines and hand to design (due Mon noon)
- Eng/Ops: implement tags in staging with hero_variant mapping (due Tue)

peter: I'll also add a measurement param to CTA links (?claim=A/B) so marketing analytics can validate creative performance.

lina: Ok team — let's keep rebuttals terse and practiceable. Lock hero by Mon so we can iterate design and routing. Thanks! :sparkles:
